Runtime support for designerless EF Core migrations on PostgreSQL. Without a Designer target model EF ignores oldType, so a nullability-only AlterColumn would also emit ALTER COLUMN ... TYPE (an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock). Call options.UseDesignerlessMigrations() after UseNpgsql().
